scope.purpose: preserve the already retained attempt-3 evidence beyond the GitHub Actions artifact expiration without changing its bytes, scientific disposition, or attempt accounting

common_preservation_requirements.preservation_object: the exact 977314-byte GitHub Actions artifact ZIP; the embedded raw response, headers, receipts, timestamps, failure package, exit codes, and runtime/source identities remain byte-for-byte inside it
detached_custody_manifest_fields: archive logical identity and physical location
original artifact name, artifact ID, workflow run ID, run attempt, creation and expiration metadata
complete embedded path, byte-count, and SHA-256 inventory
raw Content-Type and HTTP status as retained, never reconstructed
upload or archival timestamp, actor identity, authorization identity, and tool identity
quarantine, invalidity, non-promotion, and prohibited-use disposition
write_procedure: read the existing ZIP without modifying it
verify local byte count 977314 and SHA-256 a2fb41e783e80e067b958b0c0666d9e53cb36fffc591e33e04a0238f9c1c8fe4 before writing
write the ZIP once under the predeclared archive identity
write the detached custody manifest without embedding or changing protected raw bytes
read the preserved ZIP back through the ordinary retrieval path and reverify byte count and SHA-256
extract only in a quarantined verification location and verify the embedded raw response and failure-package identities
append the write and read-back receipts to the custody record; do not overwrite a prior receipt

common_preservation_requirements.failure_condition: any identity mismatch, inability to apply declared retention protection, unexpected pre-existing object, incomplete read-back, or access-control mismatch fails closed without deleting or replacing existing evidence

recommendation.reason: A compliance-retention-locked object is the smallest option that combines exact binary preservation, enforced no-delete/no-overwrite behavior, independent checksum retrieval, access separation, provider audit events, and low recurring handling risk. The existing ZIP is self-contained, so one locked ZIP plus a detached custody manifest preserves all required raw bytes and records without creating transformed evidence copies.
preconditions: a human must name and approve the exact provider and container URI
retention lock must be enabled and independently verified before the write
the exact keys, hashes, byte counts, retention-until timestamp, encryption, roles, and audit destination must be bound in the authorization
the target keys must begin absent and be create-only
an immediate full read-back and offline embedded-identity verification must be authorized
no source request, source qualification, feature/model use, overwrite, or deletion is permitted

DURABLE_RETENTION_AUTHORIZATION_PROPOSAL_ONLY

I authorize one preservation-only write of the existing 977314-byte attempt-3 GitHub artifact ZIP, SHA-256 a2fb41e783e80e067b958b0c0666d9e53cb36fffc591e33e04a0238f9c1c8fe4, to the exact approved compliance-retention-locked object container [INSERT EXACT PROVIDER AND CONTAINER URI] under create-only key mlb-source-evidence/statcast/attempt-03/run-30725195810/artifact-8826086488/shared-pa-statcast-attempt-03-30725195810.zip, together with one detached custody manifest under create-only key mlb-source-evidence/statcast/attempt-03/run-30725195810/artifact-8826086488/shared-pa-statcast-attempt-03-30725195810.custody-v1.json. The locked retention-until timestamp must be no earlier than 2033-08-02T00:00:00Z. Before writing, verify the source byte count and ZIP SHA-256. After writing, perform exactly one full evidence read-back and verify the ZIP SHA-256, embedded 2918703-byte raw-response SHA-256 0d4c91cb2d0eabaeaeed726fcf1d4aabd7f9d888fb4c9f90789a7ba679e0a968, embedded 2449-byte failure-package SHA-256 a166ab2c08c49238be1e45986764a6a7a960360d405b721602f28679e2bebdd0, and complete embedded inventory. Record authorization, actor, tool, object version, checksum, encryption, access roles, retention mode, retention-until time, write receipt, and read-back result append-only. Fail closed on any pre-existing target, identity mismatch, retention-control mismatch, access-control mismatch, or incomplete read-back. This authorization would permit only evidence retention and verification. It would not authorize a Baseball Savant or Statcast request, attempt 4, source qualification or promotion, feature construction, model fitting or scoring, prediction generation, deployment, AWS changes beyond the explicitly named preservation objects and controls, evidence deletion or overwrite, economic evaluation, wagering, or betting. Attempt 3 must remain consumed, invalid under source-contract v1, quarantined, non-promotable, and excluded from scientific use.
